findings.F1: Among grid bars where the 14-day RSI had been below 50 for 14 days or more (134 cases), the excess 7-day return rose with the length of the stretch (OLS slope +0.0031 per day, t 3.42), and the slope holds in each coin on its own (BTC t 2.15 on 61 cases, ETH t 2.62 on 73), the opposite direction to the tested idea.
findings.F2: By bucket of the signed RSI-side run, stretches below 50 of 30 days or more were followed by +3.4% excess over 7 days (n 43, t 2.01), while stretches of 14 to 30 days were followed by -3.0% (n 91, t -2.61), so the sign flips as the stretch lengthens; the long-stretch cases come from only 12 windows and are strongest in 2018 (+8.4%, n 12) and 2020 (+5.1%, n 6).
findings.F3: Over all below-50 grid bars the run length shows no monotone link to the excess 7-day return (Spearman rho 0.05, p 0.35; plan slope t 1.15), so the tested continuation reading is absent and the book earned nothing (daily mean 1.4e-05, Sharpe 0.019; its 29 worst days sum to -2.17 and its 29 best to +2.14).
findings.F4: The last day's return scaled by 20-day volatility predicts a higher excess 7-day return (slope 0.0074, t 2.33 on 671 cases; t 2.44 with the move clipped at ±3), with the same sign in both coins (BTC t 1.65, ETH t 1.70), mostly from up days (t 1.77 vs 0.27 on down days); this is borderline given the many angles looked at.
findings.F5: Saturday daily coin returns were positive on average (+0.28%, t 2.77 on 828 days), but the effect faded after 2021 (2022 -0.18%, 2023 +0.04%), so it is not counted as a lasting pattern.

ideas.idea: Once a coin's 14-day RSI has stayed below 50 for weeks, the longer that unbroken stretch has lasted up to the close, the higher the coin's return over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: A very long stretch of seller control is a reason to cover shorts or buy the coin for the following week, not to press the short.
ideas.name: long RSI-below stretch reverses

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's last 1-day return relative to its 20-day volatility of daily returns, the higher its return over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: A strong up day, large for the coin's recent volatility, is a reason to hold or add to the coin for the following week.
ideas.name: volatility-scaled daily move continues
